mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value exceeding 210.0 indicates persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 210.0), or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below 1250 and 390000 respectively signal a broad demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are below thresholds, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 4.5%), a higher unemployment rate signals deteriorating labor market conditions that lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110 signals a manufacturing contraction that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 110), or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A higher housing starts (HOUST) level is associated with stronger consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when HOUST is above 1200, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL > 210.0) leads to extended monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 210.0), or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is negative.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 > 11700), the economy approaches peak growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when GDPC1 > 11700, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
